verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents revenue attribution beyond opens and clicks. Analytics AI 'explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue', and e-commerce tracking (e.g., via the Magento integration) measures campaign ROI. The evidence is mostly marketing-level and tied to store and commerce data, and attribution of signups specifically is not shown. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on attribution mechanics and models, documented signup/conversion attribution per email or flow, attribution without a commerce integration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue—and the plain-language reason why
